value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for 1 to 3 year olds with a parent/caregiver, Term 1 Sept 14 - Nov 1, with options like Mon 9:30am, Sat 9:45am/10:30am and Sun 8:45am/9:15am - their site says.
